title: Tabs Outliner Overview
summary: A short overview of Tabs Outliner, a Chrome extension that shows browser tabs and windows as a nestable tree. It demonstrates organizing, saving and restoring tabs.
why: Commenters who struggle with tab overload use it to show what tree-based tab management looks like and recommend the extension.

quote.text: Tabs Outliner puts every tab as a leaf in a tree, and you can nest leaves
